job.title: Facades Site Manager
job.description:
About the Role

Deploy is currently working with a market-leading client within the facades space who is seeking a number of experienced, technically sharp facade site managers to support their extensive portfolio of works in the South, overseeing the full delivery of exterior building facades for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments.

The client has grown significantly over the last 12 months and is seeking to expand its site management teams in the South to support the delivery of a wide range of new and exciting projects.

As a facades site manager, you will be responsible for managing site teams of trades and labour on large, fast-moving projects. Ensuring all site activity, specifically for the facades and cladding, is running to programme and plan. You will ensure all external envelope works meet strict quality standards, fire safety regulations, program schedules, and thermal performance targets.

Additional experience with intrusive surveys and fully wrapped scaffold systems is beneficial.
This role will cover a range of façade types, including glazing, rainscreen cladding, render, steel framing (SFS), and louvres. So a strong background in delivering facade projects is essential.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of dedicated experience managing facade projects on commercial, high-rise, or large-scale developments
  • Management of the installation of cladding systems in respect of HSE, quality, programme, and resources.
  • Good communication (verbal and written) and teamwork skills
  • SMSTS & CSCS card as minimum
  • Manual handling, working at heights and Asbestos awareness trained
  • Have a real passion for the role and want to deliver an exceptional service


These are full-time/ongoing positions. We will consider applicants for contract or permanent positions. Works are Monday to Friday 07:30 am – 17:30 pm with occasional weekend overtime

Day rate/salary dependent on experience

job.title: Engineering Technician
job.description:
This opportunity is ideal for someone with the desire to learn and who has the ambition of working in the high voltage (HV) industry. It's with an engineering consultancy that has an excellent reputation for training and developing its staff and is a role that could progress into a Design or Power Systems Engineer position.

As an Engineering Technician, responsibilities will include:

  • Being based in the company's workshop performing a range of activities, such as electrical wiring and building HV panels
  • Getting involved in earthing measurements and surveys
  • Receiving full training to develop skills in earthing and HV engineering
  • Obtaining further qualifications (to degree level), paid for by the organisation
  • Developing skills in earthing engineering, covering site measurements, surveys and design, with future progression into a Power Systems Engineer role possible


Requirements:

  • A positive attitude to learning and development is essential
  • A background in hands-on electrical or mechanical installation / maintenance, pipe fitting, fire alarm installation or similar
  • The ability to read engineering drawings
  • IT literate
  • Experience with small hand tools

This is a fantastic opportunity for career growth and development in a thriving industry. An opportunity like this doesn't come along often, so don't miss out. Apply to Andrew Snelgrove at Deploy.

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
An emerging name in the UK engineering and infrastructure sectors, with a focus on the rail, highways and water industries, requires a Business Development Manager. This is a key early hire as the organisation builds its UK presence. The role is based in the Reading area, with travel mainly across London and the South East, but also further afield when necessary.

The Business Development Manager will be responsible for building the organisation's client base and pipeline, initially focusing on the highways sector.

The role:

  • Create a robust business development plan, with a focus on target clients and frameworks
  • Analyse the market and competitors
  • Identify and qualify opportunities with public sector organisations (such as local authorities), as well as tier 1 / tier 2 contractors and consultancies
  • Regularly review tender portals and frameworks for opportunities
  • Create and lead bids, managing pre-qualifications, tenders, analysis and fee proposals
  • Liaise with internal teams, taking on board their input and making commercially beneficial decisions
  • Assess pricing, contract terms and risks under FIDIC and NEC contracts
  • Play an active part in negotiations through to contract award
  • Create and nurture partnerships and joint ventures with UK companies for the delivery of highways design and project management services
  • Act as an ambassador for the company - taking part in meetings and industry events


Requirements:

  • Previous experience as a Business Development Manager in the highways, civil engineering, rail or infrastructure sectors, selling an organisation's engineering and project management services
  • Proven track record of successfully winning work in these sectors
  • Driving licence
  • Knowledge and experience of NEC and FIDIC contracts


This is an exciting opportunity for a Business Development Manager to play a pivotal role in establishing the company's presence in the UK market, shaping its growth strategy and helping drive the future direction and success of the organisation. Apply to Andrew at Deploy.

job.title: HV Design Engineer
job.description:
NERS-accredited organisation that specialises in HV design, installation and maintenance work up to 132kV requires an HV Design Engineer to join its team on a permanent basis.

Joining a thriving team with experience across HV connections, substations and civil / structural engineering, they have an excellent reputation for their high standards and a supportive working culture that encourages career progression and development opportunities.

The role:

  • Produce electrical high voltage designs for a range of infrastructure and connection projects up to 132kV
  • Act as the technical authority for these HV projects
  • Liaise with project team and external stakeholders
  • Ensure designs comply with regulations, industry standards and client requirements


The person:

  • Experienced HV Design Engineer with a track record of producing designs at 33kV - 132kV for contestable connections, power distribution / DNO projects or private networks
  • Strong understanding of the UK ICP, DNO and IDNO industry
  • Degree, HNC (or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering
  • Strong proficiency in AutoCAD
  • Knowledge of CDM Regulations
  • Experience in control and protection design and switchgear specification (desirable)


This opportunity is ideal for an HV Design Engineer with strong 33kV / 132kV experience who wants to further their career with a highly respected organisation. The role is based in East Anglia, with the possibility of hybrid working arrangements.

Apply to Andrew Snelgrove at Deploy.

job.title: Telecoms CRE
job.description:
Opportunity available on a long-term contract basis (outside IR35) for an experienced Principal Telecoms Engineer to join a major rail infrastructure programme, supporting the Cork Area Commuter Rail Project through the design and construction phases.

This is a senior technical role with responsibility across the equivalent of GRIP 4–8 / NEC contract stages, providing engineering leadership from detailed design through to construction and delivery.

Role:

As Principal Telecoms Engineer, you will be responsible for leading and overseeing telecoms design and construction activities, working closely with multidisciplinary teams, the client, contractors and international design resources.

Your responsibilities will include:


  • Undertaking CRE duties across telecoms design and construction activities.

  • Leading and reviewing telecoms networking designs, with particular expertise in MPLS-TP.

  • Participating in multidisciplinary design reviews and Interdisciplinary Checks (IDCs).

  • Managing telecoms construction activities and supporting delivery on site.

  • Taking accountability for telecoms budgets, change management and programme updates.

  • Planning and attending site visits throughout Ireland as required.

  • Coordinating telecoms disconnections and liaising with the client and subcontractors.

  • Producing Subsystem Requirement Specifications (SSRS) and associated technical documentation.

  • Working in accordance with established Alstom processes and procedures.

  • Working with the design team, via the Design Interface Manager, where appropriate.

  • Applying a strong understanding of operational railway telecoms standards across procurement, design and construction.

Requirements:

You will be an experienced railway telecoms professional with a strong track record of delivering telecoms engineering activities across complex rail projects.

You should have:


  • Proven experience undertaking CRE responsibilities for design and construction.

  • Expert-level knowledge and experience in MPLS-TP network design.

  • Strong knowledge and interpretation of operational railway telecoms standards.

  • Experience working across design and construction stages on major rail infrastructure projects.

  • Strong multidisciplinary communication and stakeholder-management skills.

  • The ability to manage technical, commercial and programme interfaces effectively.

  • Chartered Engineer status (preferred).

  • IRSE Engineering Manager Licence (preferred).

  • A valid Irish Rail PTS.

This is an excellent opportunity for a senior telecoms engineer to play a key role in the delivery of a significant Irish rail infrastructure programme, combining technical leadership, design assurance and construction delivery within a multidisciplinary environment.

If you have strong railway telecoms experience, particularly in MPLS-TP, and are looking for a senior role with genuine project responsibility, we would be keen to hear from you.

Apply to Andrew Snelgrove at Deploy.

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
Deploy Recruitment Group are seeking a Systems /Software Engineer for an initial 6 Month period


The Role:

Integration and testing of the interfaces between supplier subsystems to the clients ETCS OBU Trainguard 200 and to the UK Freight Electric, Diesel Electric/Diesel vehicles.

You will be required to integrate subsystems on Test and Integration rigs.

Update the system with new software and test prior to release for Test Support. The Test team will troubleshoot the defects found.

Roll out, test and troubleshoot software updates to systems installed on the vehicles therefore although some remote working is possible, you will be required to work on-site in the integration and test lab, at installers vehicle depots

You will be expected to configure data on the ETCS OBU System and maintain bespoke newly developed software.

The role also requires responsibility for requirements capture, development, and implementation of a remote data networking solution.

Methods and Tools:

Experience in using C++, C# Java, Python, PHP, JavaScript, jQuery and shell scripting, Git, Jira, Bugzilla, OpenGL, IBM DOORS
VOIP packet level diagnostics
Networking: (BIND/dnsmasq, dhcpd, tftp, OpenVPN)
Custom Linux systems server to embedded applications
Serial BUS analysis (RS485, MVB)

Experience:

Rail Vehicle Acceptance Testing, Instrumentation and Software Development
Railway signalling, OTMR, TPWS, ETCS
Experience of regulatory standards
Development of Safety related software
Design/Integration for RIA12 and EN 50155
Competence in Software Clearing

Qualifications:

BEng Computer Science/Software Engineering/Electrical & Electronic Engineering

job.title: Rail Systems Integration Consultant
job.description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Rail Systems Integration Consultant to support the development and delivery of integrated railway systems and civil infrastructure.

The role will provide technical integration expertise across multidisciplinary engineering and delivery teams, ensuring interfaces, requirements, risks and assurance activities are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support the identification, management and validation of technical interfaces between railway systems, civil infrastructure and other disciplines.
  • Develop and maintain interface matrices, interface registers, Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and related integration documentation.
  • Support the development and validation of system requirements and ensure interface requirements are appropriately captured and resolved.
  • Provide technical guidance to designers and delivery teams to ensure an integrated design approach.
  • Identify interface risks, develop mitigation strategies and monitor their resolution.
  • Support systems assurance activities, including integration-level reviews, compliance verification and risk-based assurance.
  • Review design submissions for compliance with applicable standards, technical requirements, codes and engineering principles.
  • Support the management of technical changes, deviations and variations and assess their potential impact on system integration.
  • Work with testing and commissioning teams to review plans, submissions and activities from an integration and compliance perspective.
  • Support the identification of system failures and improvement opportunities, using appropriate engineering and reliability analysis techniques.
  • Work collaboratively with engineering, project delivery, systems engineering, design, assurance, contractors and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the development of integration plans, technical documentation, standards and engineering processes.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives relating to safety, reliability, availability, maintainability and system performance.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering or a relevant technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 10+ years' experience in railway systems integration or a related engineering discipline.
  • Experience across the design, delivery, testing and commissioning, operation or maintenance of railway systems.
  • Experience working on complex rail or major infrastructure projects with multiple technical interfaces.
  • Professional engineering or technical certification would be advantageous.

Technical Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of systems engineering principles, including ISO 15288.
  • Knowledge of railway systems integration and EN 50126 / RAMS principles.
  • Experience with requirements, configuration and interface management.
  • Understanding of railway systems and civil infrastructure interfaces.
  • Knowledge of relevant railway, engineering, safety and regulatory standards.
  • Experience with reliability and systems analysis techniques such as FMECA, FRACAS, RCFA and RAM analysis.
  • Understanding of technical scope and change management.
  • Ability to assess design, engineering and assurance documentation against technical requirements.
  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency with relevant engineering and project management software.

Key Competencies

The successful candidate will be comfortable working across systems engineering, design, construction, assurance and commissioning, with the ability to understand complex technical interfaces and coordinate their resolution across multiple stakeholders.

They will be technically credible, highly organised and capable of translating systems engineering principles into practical project delivery outcomes.

job.title: Planning Consultant
job.description:
This is an opportunity to join a large-scale, complex rail infrastructure programme involving multiple construction disciplines, contractors, stakeholders and project interfaces.

The successful candidate will play a key role in developing, maintaining and monitoring project programmes, supporting construction planning and providing accurate planning information to project leadership and delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain and update detailed project programmes covering construction and rail delivery activities.
  • Work closely with construction, engineering, project controls and commercial teams to ensure programmes accurately reflect project requirements.
  • Develop detailed short-, medium- and long-term construction plans and lookahead programmes.
  • Monitor progress against baseline programmes and identify areas of delay, slippage or potential programme risk.
  • Analyse programme performance and provide clear reporting to project and programme management teams.
  • Support the development of recovery programmes and mitigation strategies where required.
  • Coordinate programme interfaces between different contractors, disciplines and project workstreams.
  • Ensure programme activities are logically sequenced and reflect realistic construction methodologies and site constraints.
  • Attend planning, progress and coordination meetings and provide planning input where required.
  • Work with site teams to collect and validate progress information.
  • Assist with forecasting completion dates, key milestones and critical activities.
  • Identify programme risks, constraints and opportunities and ensure these are appropriately captured.
  • Support change management and assessment of the programme impact of design, scope and construction changes.
  • Produce planning reports, dashboards, progress updates and other project controls information.
  • Ensure planning information is maintained accurately and consistently throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support the Planning Manager and wider project controls function with ad-hoc planning and analysis requirements.

Required Experience:

  • Proven experience working in rail, LRT, metro or major transportation infrastructure projects.
  • Strong experience in project planning within a construction or infrastructure environment.
  • Experience working on large, complex projects involving multiple contractors and interfaces.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, programme development and project controls.
  • Experience monitoring progress against baseline programmes and identifying programme risk.
  • Experience producing detailed construction programmes and lookahead schedules.
  • Ability to understand technical and construction information and translate this into realistic programme activities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with project managers, construction managers, engineers, commercial teams and site personnel.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Technical Skills:

Experience with Primavera P6 is highly desirable. Experience with other planning and project controls software will also be considered.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working with:

  • Baseline and live programmes
  • Critical path analysis
  • Progress measurement
  • Programme updates
  • Lookahead programmes
  • Resource and productivity information
  • Delay and impact analysis
  • Change management
  • Programme risk
  • Milestone tracking
  • Progress reporting
  • Construction sequencing

Rail / LRT Experience:

Candidates with experience across areas such as the following would be particularly relevant:

  • Light Rail Transit
  • Metro / Urban Transit
  • Track and permanent way
  • Stations
  • Civil engineering
  • Structures
  • Rail systems
  • Electrification/traction power
  • Signalling and communications
  • Utilities
  • Highways and interfaces
  • Testing and commissioning
  • Rail integration
  • Construction delivery

Personal Attributes:

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Commercially and technically aware
  • Highly organised and analytical
  • Confident working with senior project stakeholders
  • Comfortable challenging programme assumptions where appropriate
  • Proactive in identifying risks and potential delays
  • Able to communicate complex planning information clearly
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced, multidisciplinary project environment
  • Collaborative and capable of building effective relationships across multiple project teams

job.title: Signalling Project Engineer
job.description:
Deploy International Projects has an exciting position for a Signalling Project Engineer to join our valued client working on an exciting Light Rail project in the heart of Toronto, Canada.

The 19km project connects East and West Toronto, with 25 stations along its length, with 10km of this running underground and improving speeds by up to 60%

This role supports the project’s completion. Joining a team of Signalling professionals, you will provide key project support to reach deliverables and deadlines and ensure the project's delivery.

Reporting to the Signalling & Train Control Senior Project Manager, in this position, you shall be responsible for but not limited to the following:

  • Support the continuous development of Systems Integration Management for ongoing projects.
  • Maintaining and following up with project delivery issues with all applicable stakeholders.
  • Follow company safety, quality, environmental, commercial and project management procedures are followed as relevant to tasks undertaken.
  • Support coordination meetings with vendors to progress technical & commercial items
  • Oversight of installation scope (drawings/design input from vendor & coordination with installation sub)
  • Oversight and management of Systems T&C activities
  • Drive technical resolution & execution of the milestones (design workshops, implementation, installation, testing, etc.)
  • Support resolution of commercial matters with subcontractors
  • Develop reporting measures and metrics to accurately track the status of project milestones



This role is for an initial 4-6 month period and will commence in January.

Deploy is open to Applicants from the UK for this role. However, you must be able to pass a Criminal Record check for Visa purposes.

Due to this being a critical time for the project, any overseas applicants must be aware that this role requires a minimum 3-month initial stint with a 2-week break and then back for the remainder of the contract.

This is a great opportunity to gain experience within a Project that is part of a much bigger Infrastructure investment scheme in Canada. Billions of Canadian dollars will be spent over the next 10 years to truly transform Canadian commuter rail in the country.

job.title: Signalling Design Engineer
job.description:
This contract role, outside IR35, is for a Signalling Design Engineer to join a leading organisation in the rail industry.

The Signalling Design Engineer will be responsible for the production of signalling system designs, covering standard trackside equipment, as well as more complex projects.

Duties:

  • Carrying out design and design checks of signalling systems, in accordance with standards, industry codes and Signalling Design Specifications
  • Liaise with stakeholders to ensure successful project outcome
  • Provide guidance to junior design engineers
  • Assist with design risk assessments


Qualifications and Experience:

  • Previous experience in signalling design for the rail sector is essential
  • Engineering qualification (HNC, HND, degree, or equivalent)
  • Experience of the following is beneficial - LAP, scheme plans, specifications. Fringe Designs, SSI Wiring, SSI (Westlock) data and control systems
  • IRSE Signalling Designer and Verifier Licence (desirable)

If you're a Signalling Design Engineer ready for a new challenge, apply to Andrew Snelgrove at Deploy.

job.title: Lead Signalling Design Engineer
job.description:

  • Ensuring designs can be constructed and installed safely, in line with customer requirements and industry specifications
  • Making sure project timescales and budgets are adhered to

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Signalling Design Engineer. Apply to Andrew Snelgrove at Deploy.

job.title: Principal Contract Monitor
job.description:
What are my responsibilities?

  • Provide PC support and ensure compliance with the CDM regulations throughout the lifecycle of the project under direction from the PC Manager and Construction Manager.
  • Oversee on site Noise Notices/Section 61 requirements.
  • Assist PC Manager regarding specific access/land/welfare requirements.
  • Maintain condition and standard of welfare on site and within satelite depots.
  • Deliver the PC induction as required.
  • Working with relevant individuals/organisations to resolve PC issues.
  • Undertake ALO Co-ordinator duties on site as identified.
  • Assist with building effective relationships with the Customer and Sub-Contractors.
  • Be the on-site point of contact on behalf of SML with all contractors for Principal Contractor matters.
  • Ensure that PC Manager / Senior management is kept informed of non-compliance, accidents, incidents or close calls via SML reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure that plant, tools and equipment being used on SML works are certificated, maintained and safe prior to accessing SML sites.
  • Carry out regular safety and quality audits on all sub-contractors, suppliers and operatives accessing SML sites.

  • PTS & SWL/COSS Competence.
  • Valid Driving Licence.

  • Good interpersonal skills.

  • Knowledge of ALO requirements and processes.
  • ALO Co-Ordinator
  • Knowledge of High Voltage cables and procedures. HV COMP/Assessor
  • Proactive Attitude towards Health and Safety.
  • Level C or B (preferred but not mandatory)

job.title: Project Engineering Manager (Train Systems)
job.description:
Senior Project Engineer / Project Engineering Manager

Freight ETCS | Derby | Rail

We are looking for a Senior Project Engineer / Project Engineering Manager to join a major Freight ETCS programme, providing technical direction and support to Project Engineers working across the project.

The Freight ETCS project supports the rollout of ETCS Onboard solutions across the UK freight locomotive fleet, with locomotives at different stages of the project lifecycle. This includes design, first-in-class installation, fleet production and type testing.

This is an opportunity to play an important role within the ETCS Onboard Engineering team, helping to ensure engineering activities and deliverables are understood, planned and delivered in line with project requirements and schedules.

Key Responsibilities

  • Play a lead role within the ETCS Onboard Engineering team, ensuring project-related engineering deliverables are understood and implemented in line with project schedules.
  • Provide direction and support to Project Engineers working across the project.
  • Ensure the engineering team develops and monitors engineering plans, reporting progress against budget and timeline.
  • Identify issues and potential delays and take proactive and decisive action where required.
  • Work closely with the Head of Engineering and Work Package Managers to support efficient project and engineering delivery.
  • Promote engineering excellence through consistent practices and the identification and adoption of improved processes, tools and ways of working.
  • Review engineering requirements and provide written comments and feedback as required.
  • Participate in engineering and technical reviews.
  • Review engineering deliverables to ensure they are complete, consistent and meet project requirements.
  • Work with subcontractors and fitment partners throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support the delivery of engineering activities associated with the installation, testing and commissioning of modified rail vehicles.
  • Maintain a strong focus on customer requirements, quality and safety throughout all engineering activities.

Essential Experience & Qualifications

job.title: CSCS Labourer
job.description:
Deploy is looking for multiple experienced CSCS Operatives for a long-term project based in North Acton.

You will be working on a data centre project which has planned works spanning the next 2 years.

The client headlining this project has multiple sites across London that they are keen to use and develop staff over the duration of the ongoing work.

We are initially looking for CSCS labourers looking to progress and advance their careers, with other positions expected to open up once the job has started.

Duties as a labourer will consist of moving materials around site as well as assisting other tradesmen (electricians, mechanical fitters etc…)

Applicants should have/be:

- Previous and recent experience in construction over the past few years

- Punctual (there is a 0-tolerance policy on lateness – you will be removed from site if you are late)

- In-date CSCS card (looking to complete SSSTS)

- Ability to Accurately store and repair pallets so they can be moved around site

- Local enough to commute using methods other than driving due to no parking availability – closest train stations are North Acton and Wilsden junction

- Be able to use your own initiative when completing tasks in a safe and efficient manner

- Be in compliance with the RTW legislation put in place by the UK government

Job details:

Standardised hours: 0730 – 1730 (0.5 hours pay deducted for lunch break)

Overtime: After 1730 + optional weekends (paid @ 1.5 the standardised rate)

Standardised rate: 14.75

To apply, please attach an updated CV.
